landing.hero.title: Report a problem in your pincode. Track it until it's fixed.
landing.hero.body: Your report goes straight to the department that fixes it. You get a ticket ID and a date to expect the work by.
landing.pincode.label: Your pincode
landing.pincode.hint: 6 digits, like 144401. It's printed on any letter or bill sent to your home.
landing.pincode.errorLeadingZero: Pincodes don't start with 0. Check the first digit and try again.
landing.how.title: How it works
landing.how.pincodeBody: We check that your area is covered and show the localities inside it.
landing.how.pinTitle: Drop a pin on the map
landing.how.pinBody: Place it where the problem is. The pin stays inside your pincode, so the report reaches the right office.
landing.how.ticketTitle: Get a ticket ID and track it
landing.how.ticketBody: Keep the ticket ID. It shows which department has your report, what they've done and when it should be fixed.
landing.stats.title: Reports at a glance
landing.timeline.title: Follow your report from start to finish
landing.timeline.body: Every report gets a ticket like this one. Each time someone works on it, a new line appears, with the date and the department.
landing.timeline.issueTitle: Streetlight not working near Model Town market
landing.timeline.submittedNote: Reported by a resident, with a photo.
landing.timeline.assignedNote: Sent to Streetlights, Phagwara Municipal Corporation.
landing.timeline.resolvedNote: You'll see a photo of the repaired light here.
landing.trust.title: What you can count on
landing.trust.deadlineBody: Each kind of problem has a time limit set by your municipal corporation. The clock starts when you submit. If the date passes, the ticket goes up to a senior officer.
landing.trust.deadlineExpected: Reported 21 Nov, 6:00 PM. Expected by 24 Nov, 6:00 PM.
landing.trust.photosBody: Staff add a photo when they finish the work, next to the one you sent. If it isn't fixed, you can reopen the ticket.
landing.trust.departmentsBody: Your pincode tells us which municipal corporation to send it to. The kind of problem decides the department.
landing.footer.copyright: © {year} Nivaran. Civic issue reporting for Indian cities.
landing.stats.none: Counts appear here once the first reports are in.
